system.description:
When a Bell Wire is triggered, you can choose to instead mark them as a Lingering Bell. A creature marked as a Lingering Bell remains marked for up to 1 minute. You can spend your Bonus action on your turn or Reaction on other creatures turn to detonate a Lingering Bell. Once detonated, all creatures within 20-feet of a Lingering Bell must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, they become Slowed and gain 1 rank of Concussed.

Increase the ranks of Concussed by +1 at 7th and 15th levels.
